name: Good Neighbor
headline: More time for the place you call home.
description: Thoughtful help with everyday home care. Tell us what you need, and let’s make a plan that fits.

services.name: Everyday care
services.description: A helping hand for the recurring tasks that keep your home feeling good.

services.name: A fresh start
services.description: Focused help when a space needs extra attention and a little more time.

services.name: Your next chapter
services.description: Support for moving, settling in and making a space your own.

copy.servicesHeading: A little support. A lot more possibility.
copy.processHeading: Good work starts with a conversation.

processSteps.title: Tell us about your space.
processSteps.description: Share what you need and the timing you have in mind.

processSteps.title: Agree on the details.
processSteps.description: Confirm the scope, price and availability before anything is scheduled.

processSteps.title: Make it your own.
processSteps.description: Ask questions, share priorities and find a plan that works for you.

faqs.question: What happens when I get in touch?
faqs.answer: A conversation comes first. A request does not confirm a booking; scope and availability need to be agreed.

faqs.question: What if I’m not sure which service fits?
faqs.answer: Describe what you need help with. We can start there.
